carbon_policy_signal.item: EU methane reporting delay removes compliance costs on gas operators; Macron pushes regulatory relief to unlock negotiated Russian supply.
carbon_policy_signal.why_it_matters: Regulatory cost removal and Russian gas unlocking lower marginal cost of thermal generation, reducing merit-order position for coal and pushing carbon down via lower emissions-intensive dispatch.

freshness_caveat: Coal data stale as of 2025-12-26 (272 days old) and clean_dark as of 2025-12-31 (267 days old); fuel-switch economics may not reflect current margins. All other metrics current as of 2026-09-23 or 2026-09-24.
risk_flags: US supplies >50% EU diesel; 90-day ban would compress refinery margins and force power plants to switch to gas (TTF upside 10–15% risk).
Storage 70.24% full, 15.6 pp below 5-yr seasonal; refill pace into Q4 will determine winter heating demand and thermal dispatch risk.
Macron ceasefire negotiation could unlock Russian supply, collapsing TTF (–15–20% downside) and GB-DE spread if geopolitical tail-risk reprices.
Coal at 7th pctile (96 USD/t) but data stale (272 days); clean dark 47th pctile — fuel switch economics are tight, vulnerable to margin compression.

base.summary: US diesel ban threat priced in; refinery margins tighten moderately; TTF holds 70–75 EUR/MWh; GB Power eases 5–8%.

downside.summary: Macron ceasefire negotiation unlocks Russian gas supply; methane reporting delay approved; regulatory floor removed; energy truce reprices geopolitical tail.

upside.summary: US diesel ban announced with imminent 90-day timeline; refinery output collapses; power plants forced to gas; storage drawdown accelerates.

themes: US diesel export ban threatens EU refinery margins and fuel-to-gas switching
GB Power extended; storage 15.6 pp below seasonal drives winter refill urgency
Macron energy truce could unlock Russian gas; regulatory relief removes policy floor
Coal near 7-yr lows; clean spark negative signals thermal dispatch weakness
top_drivers: US diesel export ban threat (>50% EU supply at risk) forces power plants to switch to gas; TTF upside 10–15% in compression scenario.
GB Power at 93rd pctile (163.24 EUR/MWh) reflects storage 15.6 pp below seasonal; winter refill urgency lifts thermal dispatch call.
Macron ceasefire negotiation with Russia could unlock gas supply, creating 15–20% downside tail-risk repricing in TTF and power spreads.
top_takeaway: GB Power at 93rd percentile amid US diesel export ban threat and geopolitical energy shock; TTF 74th pctile reflects gas-for-coal switch risk if refinery margins compress.

watchlist.why: 90-day timeline triggers refinery-to-gas fuel switch and TTF upside within weeks; direct EU energy security shock.
Margin compression signals; output risk for power plants and Cal+1 spread widening if passed.
